note: The build half of argument binding: the parameter list the signature parse records for each export. Binding the arguments to it is the step runner's (C3a).

cases.title: named parameters, a default and an optional one, in declaration order
cases.rest_in: C3a binds the args of WR-6/a to WR-6/c through this signature

given.source: export function main(a: number, b = "dflt", c?: string) { return [a, b, c ?? "none"]; }

cases.title: an arrow main is not recognised, so its rest parameter is not parsed and the list is empty
cases.rest_in: C3a calls it with no arguments

cases.title: a zero-parameter export reached by an override has an empty list
cases.rest_in: C3a applies the WR-V1 fallback for the override
